thread:
jordy: saw a p95 east-west latency jump ~100ms during the 11:00-11:05 batch window between rack-7 and rack-3 GPU pods. Graphs show a tight correlation with the batching ramp. anyone seeing this?

sre-bot: [ALERT] e2w-latency-p95 > 80ms on cluster-gpu-us-east-2 between 11:02-11:04. Incident INC-2245 created.

maria: yup, seeing it in our traces. p50 looks fine, but p95/p99 spike only during batch ramp. looks like extra queueing or a longer path.

chris: can you paste a traceroute between two affected containers/nodes? also check for any recent MTU/kernel changes in the fleet.

jordy: traceroute seems odd — there's an extra hop through spine-2 that wasn't there on baseline. pasted output: ```traceroute -n 10.0.7.23
1 10.0.7.1 0.123 ms
2 10.1.3.254 0.456 ms
3 10.2.1.13 101.234 ms
4 10.0.3.23 101.345 ms```

alex: ran ethtool stats on the NICs of one impacted node. seeing rx_no_buf spikes on mlx5 interface during the window. short snippet: ```ethtool -S mlx5_core
rx_no_buf: 1423
rx_missed: 0
tx_timeout: 0``` Might indicate buffer exhaustion when batches peak.

leo: heads-up — we rolled out an ECMP hash tweak as part of rack-consolidation at 10:50. that could cause path selection to shift to spine-2. @maria can you check switch flow counters + ECMP distribution?

maria: pulling counters now. spine-2 shows asymmetric queue occupancy; port 48 on spine-2 has high buffer occupancy but no drops. also noticed MTU discrepancy on tor-3: config shows mtu 1500, but earlier we had 9000 jumbos enabled. snippet: ```show interfaces tor-3/48
mtu 1500
admin mtu 9000 earlier```

chris: MTU mismatch + new ECMP paths = possible fragmentation or extra CPU copy on the data path -> latency amplification. what's RDMA reporting? any psm2/connect retries?

jordy: RDMA counters spiked too — saw retries up ~60 in that window on ib0. logs: ```psm2_retry: 62```

alex: temporary mitigation idea: steer rack-local pod traffic to prefer the original TOR path (policy-rack7) until we fix MTU/ECMP. that should avoid the hm longer spine hop.

maria: applied a traffic steering rule at 11:20 to prefer rack-local paths. p95 dropped back to baseline within ~2 minutes after the change.

leo: created NET-2246 to reconcile MTU settings across TORs and to roll back the ECMP tweak on a small canary. action items: restore uniform 9000 MTU where supported, run e2e RDMA smoke, and re-run the ECMP change behind a canary gate.

jordy: great work team — please add any follow-ups to INC-2245. i'll draft the postmortem with timeline and mitigations. :thumbsup:
